adverse_events.description: Every adverse event occurrence listed in the primary patient-level adverse-event listing. Extract one row per printed adverse event occurrence. Copy subject-level context such as subject_id, site_id, treatment_group, age_years, sex, and race from the subject header above the event rows. Do not extract zero-event subject blocks, legends, footnotes, summaries, serious-only repeats, related-only repeats, AESI-only repeats, concomitant medications, protocol deviations, or any supportive listing outside the primary adverse-event listing.

subject_id.description: The subject or participant identifier from the subject block containing the event.

site_id.description: The site identifier associated with the subject.

treatment_group.description: The randomized or assigned treatment group for the subject at the time of the event.

age_years.description: The subject age in years as printed in the subject header.

sex.description: The subject sex as printed in the subject header.

race.description: The subject race as printed in the subject header.

system_organ_class.description: The system organ class for the adverse event.

system_organ_class_code.description: The MedDRA-style numeric code printed alongside the system organ class label, when present.

preferred_term.description: The coded preferred term for the adverse event.

preferred_term_code.description: The MedDRA-style numeric code printed alongside the preferred term label, when present.

lower_level_term.description: The lower level term printed below the preferred term, when present. May equal the preferred term or be a finer-grained descriptor.

lower_level_term_code.description: The MedDRA-style numeric code printed alongside the lower level term, when present.

verbatim_term.description: The investigator-reported or verbatim event term, preserving the printed wording.

start_date.description: The event start date in ISO format.

end_date.description: The event end date in ISO format, or null when ongoing or blank.

relative_start_day.description: The event start study day relative to first dose or procedure day.

relative_end_day.description: The event end study day relative to first dose or procedure day, or null when ongoing or blank.

duration_days.description: The printed or inferable duration in days when present for the event.

serious.description: Whether the event is marked serious.

relationship_to_study_product.description: The investigator relationship assessment to the study product or procedure.

action_taken.description: The action taken with study product because of the event.

aesi_category.description: The adverse-event-of-special-interest category printed for the event, when the event matches one of the study's AESI definitions. Null when the event is not flagged as an AESI.

narrative_reference.description: The narrative cross-reference identifier (e.g. 'Narrative 14.3.2.S001') printed for the event when a per-event narrative exists. Null when no narrative is referenced.
